exact_source_evidence: F0683 is defined in Toolchains/Common/Source/IMAGE3.C:612-829. Its I34E/I34M assembly addresses G2160_puc_Bitmap_Destination (IMAGE3.C:620), reverses packed nibbles through V0681000_table (IMAGE3.C:654-678, 694-702, 756-785, 799-826), and is called by F0684 only for horizontal flip with transparency (IMAGE3.C:904-925). It has no EXETYPE == C25_VGA branch. The actual C25 VGA emitter is F0680 in IMAGE5.C:936-1010: it writes to A000h (940-941), expands each 4-bit source pixel to an 8-bit VGA byte, and ORs G8177_c_ViewportColorIndexOffset (942-1006).

finding: The implementation may model part of IMAGE3.C's packed-nibble flip-and-transparency transformation, but it is not an implementation of the requested C25 VGA path and cannot establish F0683 as a PC3.4 VGA mapping. Its source-evidence string incorrectly treats IMAGE3.C:612-829 as an I34E PC3.4 C25 VGA body.
